# Security Policy

## Reporting
Do not publish exploitable vulnerabilities, credentials or personal data in public issues. Report security concerns privately to the repository owner through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature when available.

## Scope
This project is an engineering-agent framework and skills library. Security reports should include affected commit/version, impact, reproducible steps and a proposed mitigation where possible.

## Safe harbor
Only test systems and environments you own or have explicit written authorization to assess. MAXIMO's skills do not grant authorization to scan or exploit third-party systems.
